title: Require owner in validateApp and pass team from package.json in core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching package.json team. Assumptions: owner values hardcoded (apps are inlined into browser bundles so can't read package.json at runtime); shared-contracts lives in the monorepo so a single PR sufficed; platform-kit untouched. All three apps build locally; CI and CD green.
